about_the_game:
Chapter 1: The Last Bastion

The city has fallen. The world as we knew it is gone, overrun by creatures that defy nature. You and a handful of survivors have one last refuge: the Base, powered by a fragile Reactor. Lose it, and everything is over.

But survival isn’t just about hiding. The ruins hold scrap metal, forgotten weapons, and lost technology—resources that could turn the tide. Every day is a fight to gather, build, and prepare before night falls. Because when the sun sets, they come.

Chapter 2: The Portals Open

The city is divided into six districts, each home to portals pulsing with unknown energy. No one knows who built them or why. But one thing is certain: they are the source of the horrors hunting us.

To stop the spread, the portals must be activated. But the moment they awaken, waves of creatures flood the streets, hunting anything in their path. You can run. You can hide. Or you can stand and fight.

Chapter 3: The Price of Power

There is a secret buried in the city—an ancient, glowing substance known as Void Shards. It’s the key to unlocking the strongest weapons, the most powerful defenses. But there’s only one way to get it: defeating the beasts guarding the portals.

If you succeed, you’ll push humanity one step closer to reclaiming the world. If you fail, the creatures will consume everything, and the city will reset… as if you were never there.

The question isn’t if you’ll fight. The question is: how long can you last?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4690 / AMD
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 / RX VEGA-56
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: The city is lost, overrun by creatures from ancient portals. Your last refuge is the Base—if its Reactor falls, it's over. Scavenge, build, and defend. Activate portals to unleash the horde, defeat their boss, and claim Void Shards to unlock true power. How long can you last?
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Ukrainian, Japanese
